Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 123: June 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #123 shipped to subscribers in May 2011 (bearing the cover date of June 2011 for Issue 123). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #123 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Captain America: Super Soldier (third-person action-adventure)
NCAA Football 12 (sports simulation)
Call of Juarez: The Cartel (first-person shooter)
Bastion (Xbox Live Arcade action role-playing game)
From Dust (Xbox Live Arcade god simulator puzzle)
Insanely Twisted Shadow Planet (Xbox Live Arcade side-scrolling action-adventure)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring E3 2011 preview coverage for Halo 4, Gears of War 3, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, and Forza Motorsport 4, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
